from z3 import *
import itertools

# Create solver
s = Solver()

# Create 7x7 grid
X = [[Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(7)] for i in range(7)]

# Each cell between 0 and 6
for i in range(7):
    for j in range(7):
        s.add(X[i][j] >= 0, X[i][j] <= 6)

# Idempotent: diagonal is i
for i in range(7):
    s.add(X[i][i] == i)

# Latin square: each row and column permutation of 0-6
for i in range(7):
    s.add(Distinct([X[i][j] for j in range(7)]))
    s.add(Distinct([X[j][i] for j in range(7)]))

# QG3: x[ x[i][j] ][ x[j][i] ] == i for all i,j
for i in range(7):
    for j in range(7):
        # x[ x[i][j] ][ x[j][i] ] == i
        s.add(X[ X[i][j] ][ X[j][i] ] == i)

# Check satisfiability
print(s.check())

table = Array('table', IntSort(), IntSort())

    for j in range(7):
        s.add(table[i*7 + j] >= 0)
        s.add(table[i*7 + j] <= 6)
# Idempotent

    s.add(table[i*7 + i] == i)
# Latin rows

    row = [table[i*7 + j] for j in range(7)]
    s.add(Distinct(row))
# Latin columns
for j in range(7):
    col = [table[i*7 + j] for i in range(7)]
    s.add(Distinct(col))
# QG3: table[ table[i*7+j] *7 + table[j*7+i] ] == i   for all i,j
for i in range(7):
    for j in range(7):
        idx1 = table[i*7 + j]
        idx2 = table[j*7 + i]
        s.add(table[idx1 * 7 + idx2] == i)
print(s.check())
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    sol = [m.eval(table[i*7+j]).as_long() for i in range(7) for j in range(7)]
    print(sol)
